sql: select id, started_at, round(extract(epoch from finished_at-started_at)::numeric,1) as secs, programs_listed, liquidity_programs, new_terms, changed_terms, disappeared, errors, notes_json->>'deferred_new_terms' as deferred, (select max(last_seen_at) from incentive_programs) as max_last_seen, now() as db_now from incentive_discovery_cycles where started_at > now() - interval '2 hours' order by started_at desc limit 10
